architecture: Native WPF UI + fixed-command Windows service + bundled protected PowerShell 7.6.6 backend; owned ctrld SCM service + Loopback ULA + DoH + NRPT + zapret/WinDivert; service-mediated verified direct updater

usage.onlineUpdate: Direct in-app update: privileged service fetches GitHub latest release, cross-checks GitHub asset SHA-256 digest with SHA256SUMS.txt, verifies downloaded installer, then runs silent Inno Setup without UAC.

limitations: Effectiveness may vary if the network filtering implementation changes.
